messages.text: Look, Mouse found a horse. Listen first. It's a horse. Your turn. It's a horse.[TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
That's okay. Let's try again. It's a horse. Your turn. It's a horse.[TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
The horse has cake on its mouth.
You saw cake on its mouth. Let's watch and find out.[TEACHER_POINT_TO_SCREEN][NEXT_STEP]
